summary: Streamline your ISO 28000 transition journey. Explore our in-depth guides and best practices to enhance your supply chain security and operational efficiency.
audienceIntro: This PECB Certified ISO 28000 Transition course is essential for professionals who need to update their expertise and ensure their organization's security management system aligns with the latest international standard. This course is designed for: SeMS Managers responsible for updating existing security management systems. Security Professionals seeking to understand ISO 28000:2022 requirements. Compliance Officers tasked with ensuring conformity to the new standard. ISO 28000 Consultants advising clients on SeMS transition strategies. Internal Auditors evaluating SeMS against ISO 28000:2022 clauses. Risk Managers integrating security and resilience into organizational frameworks. Supply Chain Security Managers adapting to the broader scope of ISO 28000:2022. Professionals wishing to update their ISO 28000 certification to the latest version. Individuals involved in maintaining an organization's security management system. Decision-makers requiring insight into the strategic implications of ISO 28000:2022.
modules: Introduction to ISO 28000:2022 and Key Changes
prerequisites: To fully benefit from this training course, you should have a general understanding of security concepts and the requirements of ISO 28000:2007.
